description: This PHP class, PimCsvDataImport, is responsible for importing employee data from CSV files into the OrangeHRM system. It parses each row of data, validates fields, and creates Employee entities with detailed attribute handling, including name, ID, contact details, gender, marital status, nationality, date of birth, address, and email. The class also interacts with country and nationality services to validate and fetch related references.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImport
classes.description: Handles the import of employee data from CSV format, validating inputs and creating Employee entities within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Main function to import employee data from an array of fields, performing validation and saving the employee record.

methods.name: getDateTimeIfValid
methods.description: Converts a string to a DateTime object if valid, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: getNationalityIfValid
methods.description: Fetches a Nationality entity by name if valid, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Returns an instance of the NationalityService used for nationality lookups.

methods.name: getCountryCodeIfValid
methods.description: Returns the country code if the country name is valid and found.

methods.name: getCountryService
methods.description: Retrieves the country service from the container for country lookups.

methods.name: getProvinceIfValid
methods.description: Returns the province code if the province name is valid and found.

methods.name: isValidPhoneNumber
methods.description: Checks if the phone number is valid using predefined validation rules.

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks if the email is unique across employee records.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Ensures the employee ID is unique.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Utility method to check if a string is empty or null.
